subject: Performance remediation package for Apex Retail - latency shortfall
messages:
From: Sara Park <sara@apexretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood performance concerns this week

Hi Sean,

We're seeing recurring tail-latency spikes on our production route (model: rdx-large) over the past 72 hours. Spikes are most visible during our peak window (14:00-16:00 ET) where p95 latency jumped from ~160ms to 720-900ms intermittently. This is materially impacting our checkout recommendation microflow — we lost several transactions yesterday.

Can you share what happened and what remediation you can offer? Our procurement lead asked whether Redwood will provide a one-time credit or expedited mitigation given the impact. We need a single point of contact and an expected timeline.

Thanks,
Sara Park
Director, Platform Engineering
Apex Retail

Attachment: error-samples.log (text)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sara Park <sara@apexretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood performance concerns this week

Hi Sara — thanks for flagging and apologies for the disruption. I'm on it and looping in Laura from Customer Success to coordinate the immediate mitigation and a proposed remediation package.

Quick notes:
- We observed an anomalous scheduler bump tied to a noisy tenant in the same shard during your peak window; our infra team pushed a priority fix yesterday evening that reduced the variance.
- We're running a deeper KV cache warmup and rolling a kernel tweak that should stabilize p95 across the fleet by tomorrow.

Proposed next steps (I'll confirm with CS + sales ops):
1) Immediate: continue the mitigation (ETA 24 hours).
2) Short-term remediation offer: a one-time credit to compensate for measurable impact + 1 month of free burst capacity (to cover traffic surges) while we monitor.
3) Follow-up: delivery of a latency analysis report and a 30-day watch.

I'll get back with a concrete credit number and signoff path by COB tomorrow.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood performance concerns this week — proposed remediation package (need approval)

Laura / Marissa — forwarding Sara's note and the initial technical summary from infra (attached). Customer is asking for a one-time concession tied to the outage/latency shortfall while we stabilize. Details:

- Account: Apex Retail (APX-783), committed monthly spend ~$120k.
- Impact window: 2026-08-21 through 2026-08-24 (peaks during peak hours).
- Measured loss: estimated 0.9% of checkout throughput during peak window; customer flags direct revenue impact.

Suggested remediation package to propose to the customer:
- One-time bill credit equal to 8% of their committed monthly spend (approx $9,600) applied to next invoice, OR
- Alternatively, 1 month of complimentary Dedicated burst capacity (up to $12k value) + 3 months of elevated support (no charge) — customer can choose which fits procurement better.
- Delivery: include latency-analysis-aug2026.pdf and a 30-day watch agreement; provide DocuSign for the acceptance of credits/terms.

Why this ask: this is a strategic retail account with a runway to expand. We want to retain trust without setting an overly generous precedent. I need exec signoff on the 8% one-time credit or greenlight on the alternate package. Karthik, is there any legal/contractual constraint if we deliver a credit vs. free burst capacity?

Thanks — Sean

Attachment: proposed-remediation-credit-summary.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood performance concerns this week — proposed remediation package (need approval)

Team — reviewed. I approve offering the alternate package (1 month complimentary burst capacity + 3 months elevated support) for Apex Retail. Rationale:
- Keeps cash exposure lower while preserving perceived value to the customer.
- Avoids setting a precedent for large flat percentage credits tied to latency variance.
- Gives us an operational runway to complete the stabilization and demonstrate improvements.

Please proceed: Sean, send the option letter to Sara with the DocuSign link. Laura, work with Finance to put a memo on file and mark the account for a 30-day post-mitigation review. Karthik, confirm any contract addendum language required; if not, proceed with standard amendment template.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
